card.name: Last digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The final digit (often 7, 8 or 9) of a number written as separate digits, such as a group size, day count or age, in clinical trial text. It is usually the digit that ends the number.

modes.label: Group sizes
modes.description: Final digit of a patient count in parentheses or a table.

modes.label: Days and ages
modes.description: Final digit of a day count, hour count or age near 'or' or 'to'.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number in trial results, like a group size or number of days.
